I added `created_at` as the last column of the CSV that `toCsv` produces in `src/exports/csvExport.ts`. Each row's value is `r.createdAt.toISOString()`, for example `2026-10-16T12:00:00.000Z`. I haven't run or tested it.

I put the new column at the end so existing columns keep their positions for anyone parsing the file by index. I used ISO format because `createdAt` is a `Date`, and `String(date)` would give a locale-style string that's awkward to parse.

This changes the export format, so per the team notes you should tag @jordan on the PR.
